page.layout: One page of text, one column, full width. Running head with page number at the top. No marginal notes. Closing word FINIS below the text, then a woodcut tailpiece.

main_text.p: Laurentium, quam in hac disputatio-ne fideliter sequuti sumus, prout etiam cæteros auctores bona fide al-legavimus.

Et sic quidem Magistratus potestatem in rebus Ecclesiasticis vindicavimus breviter adversum Bellarm. Proximâ disputatione ministerii Ecclesiastici naturam, dignitatem, jura contra eundem asseremus volente Domino.

page.notes: Woodcut tailpiece (ornament with a central rectangular panel and scrollwork, above a pendant) below FINIS; it is not text. Some scattered specks and a light "Digitized by Google" watermark at lower right, which were left out. The word "asseremus" at the line end is slightly smudged; the reading is likely but not certain. The spelling "Ecclesiasticis" and "Ecclesiastici" are as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
